standard-dialogue-talk-to.npc: Everything! The wonders right here in this museum, collected from all corners of the land.

standard-dialogue-talk-to.player: I guess it is, you're right.

standard-dialogue-talk-to.text: If the player has a collection log in their inventory or bank:
If the player does not have a collection log in their inventory or bank:

steps.npc: Matter of fact, I consider myself quite the collector. I keep a record of just about everything that I find!
Would you like one? You could keep track of your own collections.

steps.player: No thanks. I think I'll pass.

steps.npc: I should've guessed you wouldn't understand the true beauty of a good collection!

standard-dialogue-get-log.text: If the player does not have a collection log in their inventory or bank:

steps.text: The collector gives you a collection log.

steps.npc: There! Now you'll be able to see the true beauty of everything you collect on your adventures.

standard-dialogue-get-log.text: If the player does not have a collection log and attempts to claim one with a full inventory:

steps.npc: You might struggle to carry that right now.

steps.player: Oh... I'll come back when I'm carrying a little less.

standard-dialogue-get-log.text: If the player has a collection log in their inventory or bank:

steps.npc: Don't you have one lying around somewhere already?

standard-dialogue-claim-log-rewards.player: Could you count how many uniques I've obtained in my collection?

standard-dialogue-claim-log-rewards.npc: I'd love to count everything you've collected on your adventures!
You might want to take a seat this could take a while.

standard-dialogue-claim-log-rewards.text: The collector starts counting the items in your collection.

standard-dialogue-claim-log-rewards.npc: From what I can see you have collected [number] items in your collection!

standard-dialogue-claim-log-rewards.text: If the player has more than 0-99 unique items in their collection log:

steps.npc: You've made a good start at filling your collection, keep at it!

standard-dialogue-claim-log-rewards.text: If the player has more than 100 unique items in their collection log:

steps.npc: I see you are just starting out on your collecting adventure. I wish you luck!

standard-dialogue-claim-log-rewards.text: If the player has more than 300 unique items in their collection log:

steps.npc: You've made a good start at filling your collection, keep at it!

standard-dialogue-claim-log-rewards.text: If the player has more than 500 unique items in their collection log:

steps.npc: You're starting to get a hang of this collecting business!

standard-dialogue-claim-log-rewards.text: If the player has more than 700 unique items in their collection log:

steps.npc: You have a very respectable collection indeed, one day you'll have a better collection than me!

standard-dialogue-claim-log-rewards.text: If the player has more than 900 unique items in their collection log:

steps.npc: Your collection is maturing well, you're making great strides to becoming a top collector, keep it up!

standard-dialogue-claim-log-rewards.text: If the player has more than 1000 unique items in their collection log:

steps.npc: Your collection is one of the finest I've seen, it's almost on par with mine!!

standard-dialogue-claim-log-rewards.text: If the player has more than 1100 unique items in their collection log:

steps.npc: Colour me impressed, you've collected more items than me! I look forward to seeing your collection grow even more.

standard-dialogue-claim-log-rewards.text: If the player has more than 1200 unique items in their collection log:

steps.npc: Now that's an impressive collection, I haven't seen many with a collection better than yours!

standard-dialogue-claim-log-rewards.text: If the player has registered at least 90% of all items in the collection log:

steps.npc: I can officially say that you are now an elite collector and few can stand as your equal in that regard.

standard-dialogue-claim-log-rewards.text: If the player has somehow completed the collection log:

steps.npc: Wait, you finished it? You actually finished the entire collection? I never thought that was even possible!

standard-dialogue-claim-log-rewards.npc: As an accomplished collector I'd like to offer you a special reward.

standard-dialogue-claim-log-rewards.text: Depending on what staves the player has unlocked and currently don't have in the inventory or bank:

steps.text: The collector hands you the Gilded staff of collection.
The collector hands you the Dragon staff of collection.
The collector hands you the Rune staff of collection.
The collector hands you the Adamant staff of collection.
The collector hands you the Mithril staff of collection.
The collector hands you the Black staff of collection.
The collector hands you the Steel staff of collection.
The collector hands you the Iron staff of collection.
The collector hands you the Bronze staff of collection.

standard-dialogue-claim-log-rewards.text: If the player already has all unlocked staves in their inventory or bank:

steps.npc: Actually, it appears you already have all the rewards I'd like to give you.

varlamore-token-dialogue.npc: This... idea! The idea of something nice! Those nice little tokens!

varlamore-token-dialogue.text: If the player has no red tokens in their inventory:

steps.npc: Oh, er... never you mind!

steps.text: The Collector waves at the player and disappears.

varlamore-token-dialogue.text: If the player has at least one red token in their inventory:

steps.npc: Only some? Well you need more! Until you have them, I should get going...

steps.text: The Collector waves at the player and disappears.

varlamore-token-dialogue.text: If the player has all seven red tokens in their inventory:

steps.player: Oh yes, I've got this wonderful collection of tokens!

steps.npc: May I see them?

steps.text: You show the Collector your collection of tokens.

steps.npc: May I have them?

steps.text: You hand your collection of tokens to the Collector, and in exchange he gives you some sort of a key.
The Collector waves at the player and disappears.

steps.npc: Fine.

steps.text: The Collector waves at the player and disappears.
